title: Covariant exactness of unbounded ringed internal Hom
statement: For any small ringed site and commutative ring sheaf, in any derived universe, for each fixed L the functor RHom(L,-) admits a coherent integer CommShift structure making it triangulated. There are no boundedness or finiteness hypotheses. The derived category and internal Hom are those of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-derived-internal-hom].

proof.text: Use the evaluation-normalized adjunction for the native derived tensor [lem-sf-ringed-derived-tensor-hom-adjunction], specialized to the small site while retaining the arbitrary derived-category universe. Its monoidal structure is exactly the native derived tensor [lem-sf-ringed-derived-native-tensor]. The adopted theorem DerivedCategory.isTriangulated_tensorRight proves that tensoring on the right by L is triangulated with its coherent integer shift structure. Mathlib Adjunction.rightAdjointCommShift transfers that shift structure across the adjunction; Adjunction.commShift_of_leftAdjoint proves compatibility. Mathlib Adjunction.isTriangulated_rightAdjoint now proves RHom(L,-) triangulated. The equal-universe specialization of derivedInternalHomOfUniverses is definitionally the recorded derivedInternalHom. Return the induced shift structure and this triangulatedness proof. No boundedness or flatness assumption on L is added; the sheaf category has the required functorial flat resolutions.

source.place: Tags 08J9 and 08JC; exactness of an adjoint of an exact triangulated functor.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08J9 and 08JC. Reuse the already proved native derived tensor-Hom adjunction and the generic triangulated right-adjoint theorem.

theorem ringedInternalHom_covariant_exact
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u}
    RingCat.{u})).obj R))] :
    (∀ L : (DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u}
    RingCat.{u})).obj R))), ∃ _ : ((Functor.curry.obj (derivedInternalHom.{u, w} J R)).obj (op
    L)).CommShift ℤ,
    ((Functor.curry.obj (derivedInternalHom.{u, w} J R)).obj (op L)).IsTriangulated)
